title: Extend pack-descriptor schema: resource activate_when + install fields
description: Phase F-a foundation for the Diseño Poderoso design pack. The §8 design-power resources in docs/design/addon-packs.md carry `activate_when` (an activation predicate over profile variables, e.g. "tier>=MEDIO", "framework==vue && ui_outside_canvas") and `install` (an install command string) fields, but state/pack-descriptor.schema.json's `resources[]` entries are `additionalProperties:false` and reject both — so the real design-power descriptor cannot be authored or validated. Add both as OPTIONAL resource fields (non-empty strings). Design intent (addon-packs.md §8.1): exclusion/activation is expressed as descriptor DATA — an activate_when predicate plus the already-existing per-resource `fallback` field — NOT hardcoded core logic; the resource table is a maintained manifest read at runtime. This ticket ONLY makes the schema accept + round-trip these fields; predicate EVALUATION is deferred to Phase D/F. Pipeline stays `array<string>` (no change this ticket). Scope: state/pack-descriptor.schema.json + src/pack-descriptor.js (validatePackDescriptor) + tests. Do NOT add any evaluation/activation runtime.
acceptance_criteria: validatePackDescriptor accepts a descriptor whose resources carry the OPTIONAL fields `activate_when` (string) and `install` (string); a resource omitting both still validates (backward-compatible with every existing descriptor and fixture).
When present, `activate_when` and `install` must be non-empty strings; a non-string or empty value is rejected with an error whose instancePath names the offending resource field.

resources[] remains additionalProperties:false for every OTHER key: a typo'd/unknown resource field (e.g. `activateWhen` or `installl`) is still rejected — the extension adds exactly these two named optional fields, nothing looser.

The existing design-power test fixture in tests/pack-descriptor.spec.js is extended so at least one resource uses `activate_when` + `install` and the descriptor validates; the existing required-field, duplicate-id, and fallback semantic checks are unchanged and still pass (no regression).

A schema `description` note and a one-line note in docs/design/addon-packs.md §8.1 record that activation/exclusion is descriptor data (activate_when predicate + fallback), not hardcoded core logic, and that predicate evaluation is deferred to the Phase D/F layer.
